DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening stance, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn and a written apology, with the principal next; that is not the fair outcome, which was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under 4.4, and her time ran out before you got near it.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put a document in front of her, only a score and a phrase you never named.
What cost ground: Saying that Owen cheated again and again with nothing in your hand made her dig in, and the offer of a perfect course mark for a few bullet points gave her something to report to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never named a date or a time, so it never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then lay out one dated document she could check, instead of repeating the accusation.
Thanks. What model are you actually?
